Dear Brett,

Thank you for letting us know this issue. Now the link is working.
and from MSstats v3.0.x, Maxquant output converter function is available in MSstats. R script uses this function in MSstats v3.0.6, which fixed the bug. Also example dataset is available at MSstats material github( https://github.com/MeenaChoi/MSstats_material/tree/master/example%20dataset/DDA_ControlledMixture2014). 

I hope this is helpful. If you find any bug or issue, please let us know.

Thanks.

- Meena
